acceptance.given: Package A authority and execution boundaries are defined while existing ADR ownership remains the governing baseline.

oracle.expected: A boundary check confirms ADR-0041 and ADR-0058 remain owners of toolchain replay execution and evidence boundaries, and ADR-0061 remains owner of the unchanged Phase isolation and recovery boundary.
forbidden: Package A changes or displaces the ADR-0041, ADR-0058, or ADR-0061 ownership boundaries.
oracle.observable: The boundary validation identifies all three ADRs as preserved owners and reports no displacement.

acceptance.then: The boundary check passes only when the three named ADR ownership assignments remain intact and Package A declares no authority over those boundaries.
acceptance.when: During Package A contract and scope validation, evaluate the preserved ADR ownership boundary check.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the boundary-preservation check and fail when ADR-0041, ADR-0058, or ADR-0061 is missing, reassigned, or displaced by Package A.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Preserve existing ADR ownership boundaries while defining Package A authority and execution scope.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No production state or schema changes; removing the Package A boundary declaration restores the prior authority baseline.

slice_hint.state_transition: Package A boundary definition retains the pre-existing ADR ownership assignments.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A deterministic boundary check confirms all three ADR ownership assignments are preserved and no forbidden displacement is declared.
